inspire

(verb). Truyền cảm hứng

Ex: The actors inspired the kids with their enthusiasm.

encourage

(verb). khuyến khích

Ex: My parents have always encouraged me in my choice of career.

lecture

(noun). bài giảng

Ex: She spoke about the environmental problems of the future in a lecture at Georgetown University.

institution

(noun). Tổ chức, viện

Ex: Harvard University is an internationally respected institution.

deliver

(verb). cung cấp thông tin, bày tỏ

Ex: The video delivers a clear message about road safety.

appoint

(verb). bổ nhiệm, chỉ định

Ex: They have appointed a new head teacher at my son's school.

contribution

(noun). sự đóng góp

Ex: a significant contribution to scientific knowledge Ex: He made a very positive contribution to the success of the project.

sections.title: Passage 2: Antarctica - in from the cold_
sections.html:
vegetation

(noun). Thảm thực vật

Ex: The hills are covered in lush green vegetation.

unravel

(verb). làm sáng tỏ

Ex: The discovery will help scientists unravel the mystery of the Ice Age.

revitalise

(verb). tái sinh, đem lại sức sống mới

Ex: The local economy has been revitalised.

reverberate

(verb). vang lại, dội lại

Ex: His voice reverberated around the hall.

remoteness

(noun). Sự xa xôi

Ex: Space enthusiasts will marvel at the beauty and remoteness of Pluto.

perish

(verb). tàn lụi

Ex: Early buildings were made of wood and have perished.

perception

(noun). Nhận thức

Ex: We have to change the public's perception that money is being wasted.

oscillation

(noun). dao động qua lại

Ex: the economy’s continual oscillation between growth and recession Ex: The lack of damping property also caused oscillations of relatively high frequency.

ordinary

(adjective). Bình thường

Ex: She was a perfectly ordinary little girl.

occupy

(verb). Chiếm vị trí

Ex: The bed seemed to occupy most of the room.

mountainous

(adjective). nhiều núi

Ex: The region is mountainous, with large wooded and un populated areas. Ex: In the 1920s, in mountainous areas inaccessible to wheeled transport, women raised income by carrying fragile and liquid items from trading stores.

isolation

(noun). sự cô lập, sự tách biệt

Ex: To make sense, these figures should not be looked at in isolation.

interplay

(noun). tương tác

Ex: Our personalities result from the complex interplay between our genes and our environment.

integral

(adjective). cần thiết

Ex: Music is an integral part of the school's curriculum.

ilk

(noun). cùng loại, cùng hạng

Ex: I can't stand him, or any others of that ilk.

hardship

(noun). sự gian khổ

Ex: People suffered many hardships during that long winter.

extensive

(adjective). bao quát, rộng rãi

Ex: Extensive research has been done into this disease.

extend

(verb). kéo dài, mở rộng

Ex: The Sahara Desert extends for miles.

eventually

(adverb). Cuối cùng

Ex: It might take him ages but he'll do it eventually.

enhance

(verb). tăng cường

Ex: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.

dissolve

(verb). Hoà tan

Ex: Nitric acid will dissolve most animal tissue.

deprivation

(noun). sự thiếu thốn

Ex: In the inner cities you will find neglected children suffering from social deprivation.

demand

(verb). yêu cầu

Ex: This is a very difficult piece of music to play - it demands a lot of concentration.

dedication

(noun). cống hiến

Ex: It takes dedication to be successful in a sport.

courageous

(adjective). can đảm, dũng cảm

Ex: I hope people will be courageous enough to speak out against this injustice.

conveyor belt

(noun). băng chuyền

Ex: If a conveyor belt moves too fast, parts may be damaged or the workers may not be able to keep up.

component

(noun). Thành phần

Ex: Nitrogen is the main component of air.

blizzard

(noun). bão tuyết

Ex: The blizzard struck the north-east yesterday, causing serious damage.

bleakness

(noun). sự lạnh lẽo, sự ảm đạm

Ex: Emily Brontë immortalized the bleakness of the Yorkshire Moors.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

abyssal

(adjective). sâu thăm thẳm

Ex: abyssal marine life Ex: They are found in all seas, at all latitudes, and from the intertidal to the abyssal zone.

prototype

(noun). Bản mẫu

Ex: Scientists have developed a working prototype for the machine.

prediction

(noun). Dự đoán

Ex: It's difficult to make accurate predictions about the effects on the environment.

forecast

(verb). dự báo, dự đoán

Ex: Experts are forecasting a recovery in the economy.

agriculture

(noun). Ngành nông nghiệp

Ex: The number of people employed in agriculture has fallen in the last decade.

temperature

(noun). Nhiệt độ

Ex: The climate is generally mild, and freezing temperatures are almost unknown.

vitality

(noun). sức sống, sinh khí

Ex: The music has a wonderful freshness and vitality.

owe

(verb). có được cái gì nhờ

Ex: The town owes its existence to the minerals that lie below the mountains.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

biological

(adjective). thuộc về sinh học

Ex: Eating is a biological necessity!

hemisphere

(noun). Bán cầu

Ex: Countries in both the Northern and Southern hemispheres continue to treat the world's rivers, seas and oceans as dumping grounds.

productivity

(noun). hiệu suất

Ex: Wage rates depend on levels of productivity.

staple

(adjective). sản phẩm chủ yếu

Ex: The staple crop is rice.

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

migrate

(verb). Di cư

Ex: These animals migrate annually in search of food.

so-called

(adjective). Được gọi là

Ex: How have these so-called improvements helped the local community?

record

(verb). ghi chép, ghi nhận

Ex: Unemployment is likely to reach the highest total that has ever been recorded.

overlie

(verb). nằm trên, đặt trên

Ex: The released water rises into the hot mantle overlying the Nazca slab.

fearsome

(adjective). đáng sợ

Ex: He has a fearsome reputation as a fighter.

extreme

(adjective). vô cùng, cực độ

Ex: We are working under extreme pressure at the moment.

blast

(noun). sự nổ

Ex: The blast ripped through the building.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

value

(noun). giá trị

Ex: For them, the house's main value lay in its quiet country location.

remove

(verb). loại bỏ

Ex: Remove the pan from the heat and continue to stir the sauce.

insignificant

(adjective). tầm thường, không quan trọng

Ex: The levels of chemicals in the river are not insignificant.

heroic

(adjective). anh hùng, quả cảm

Ex: Rescuers made heroic efforts to save the crew.

deed

(noun). việc làm, hành động

Ex: He tried to do a good deed every day.

continent

(noun). Châu lục

Ex: He crossed a whole continent to find his family.

apparent

(adjective). Rõ ràng

Ex: It soon became apparent to everyone that he couldn't sing.

reveal

(verb). Tiết lộ

Ex: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

massive

(adjective). to lớn

Ex: The government put massive amounts of money into the health service.

exert

(verb). Mang tác động

Ex: Some managers exert considerable pressure on their staff to work extra hours without being paid.

circulation

(noun). tuần hoàn

Ex: Rapid data circulation through digital information systems means that distance appears to shrink and time seems to collapse.

prevailing

(adjective). Thịnh hành

Ex: The prevailing view seems to be that they will find her guilty.

force

(noun). lực

Ex: The moon exerts a force on the earth.

contributory

(adjective). góp phần, đóng góp

Ex: Smoking is a contributory cause of many diseases.

circulate

(verb). lưu thông, tuần hoàn

Ex: The condition prevents the blood from circulating freely.

influence

(noun). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His early work shows the influence of Cézanne and Matisse.

rainfall

(noun). lượng mưa

Ex: There has been below average rainfall this month.

predictor

(noun). người dự đoán, điều dự đoán

Ex: Cholesterol level is not a strong predictor of heart disease in women.

predict

(verb). Dự đoán

Ex: Nobody could predict the outcome.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

significance

(noun). sự quan trọng, sự đáng kể

Ex: The new drug has great significance for the treatment of the disease.

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

emphasise

(verb). Nhấn mạnh

Ex: His speech emphasised the importance of attracting industry to the town.

repair

(verb). sửa chữa, hồi phục

Ex: We need to get the roof repaired.

receive

(verb). nhận được

Ex: We received a warm welcome from our hosts.

pasture

(noun). đồng cỏ

Ex: The sheep were grazing on the lush green pastures.

overstock

(verb). tích trữ quá nhiều

Ex: The pharmacy is overstocked with face masks in the COVID-19 pandemic.

limit

(verb). giới hạn

Ex: The amount of money you have to spend will limit your choice.

keep an eye on

(verb). chú ý, để ý

Ex: We've asked the neighbours to keep an eye on the house for us while we are away.

degradation

(noun). Sự xuống cấp

Ex: One of the effects of environmental degradation is the absence of fish in that river.

avoid

(verb). tránh

Ex: We must find a way to avoid similar problems in future.

accurate

(adjective). Chính xác

Ex: Accurate measurements are essential.

thrive

(verb). Phát triển mạnh

Ex: New businesses thrive in this area.

due to

(preposition). vì

Ex: A lot of her unhappiness is due to boredom.

abundant

(adjective). nhiều, dồi dào

Ex: Fish are abundant in the lake.

strip away

(verb). lột, gột

Ex: First, you need to strip away all the old plaster.

scour

(verb). tẩy, gột

Ex: The rush of water had scoured away the topsoil.

recent

(adjective). gần đây

Ex: The Prime Minister discussed the issue during his most recent visit to Poland.

continuously

(adverb). liên tục

Ex: You can't work continuously for six hours without a break!

spill

(verb). tràn

Ex: Water had spilled out of the bucket onto the floor.

sink

(verb). chìm

Ex: The legs of the garden chair sank into the soft ground.

remain

(verb). tồn tại

Ex: Only about half of the original workforce remains.

increasingly

(adverb). ngày càng gia tăng

Ex: Tourism is playing an increasingly important role in the region's economy

factor

(noun). Nhân tố

Ex: The result will depend on a number of different factors.

dense

(adjective). Dày đặc

Ex: The forest is quite dense at that point.

sections.title: Passage 3: Source of Knowledge
sections.html:
absurd

(adjective). vô lí, ngớ ngẩn

Ex: Of course it's not true, what an absurd idea.

antibiotics

(noun). kháng sinh

Ex: I got an antibiotic for my ear infection.

astrologer

(noun). nhà chiêm tinh

Ex: He was advised by astrologers to delay his departure

authenticate

(verb). xác thực là đúng

Ex: The letter has been authenticated by handwriting experts.

complementary

(adjective). bổ trợ, bổ sung

Ex: The school's approach must be complementary to that of the parents.

complex

(adjective). Phức tạp

Ex: We live in an increasingly complex world.

construct

(verb). xây dựng

Ex: You must learn how to construct a logical argument.

contemporary

(adjective). đương thời

Ex: He is among the best-known contemporary artists.

count

(verb). coi như

Ex: For tax purposes that money counts as income.

critically

(adverb). mang tính đánh giá, phân tích

Ex: We want all our students to develop into mature citizens who are able to think critically.

discomfort

(noun). Sự khó chịu

Ex: You will experience some minor discomfort during the treatment.

distress

(noun). đau đớn

Ex: The newspaper article caused the actor considerable distress.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

explore

(verb). khám phá

Ex: We will explore these ideas in more detail in chapter 7.

faith

(noun). niềm tin

Ex: We've lost faith in the government's promises.

hangover

(noun). dư vị khó chịu sau khi uống quá nhiều thức uống có cồn

Ex: She woke up with a terrible hangover.

holistic

(adjective). tổng thể

Ex: My doctor takes a holistic approach to disease.

instrument

(noun). Công cụ

Ex: This pen is the ideal precision instrument for all your graphic needs.

interpret

(verb). Diễn giải

Ex: The data can be interpreted in many different ways.

notify

(verb). thông báo

Ex: Competition winners will be notified by post.

observation

(noun). sự quan sát

Ex: Most information was collected by direct observation of the animals' behaviour.

otherwise

(adverb). nếu không thì

Ex: My parents lent me the money. Otherwise, I couldn't have afforded the trip.

priest

(noun). linh mục, thầy tu

Ex: Only one or two new priests were ordained each year.

privileged

(adjective). ưu thế

Ex: Those in authority were in a privileged position.

proceed

(verb). chuyển sang làm gì, tiếp tục

Ex: He outlined his plans and then proceeded to explain them in more detail.

proof

(noun). bằng chứng

Ex: These results are a further proof of his outstanding ability.

respect

(noun). khía cạnh, phương diện

Ex: In this respect we are very fortunate.

sanction

(verb). thừa nhận, đồng ý

Ex: Slavery was once socially sanctioned.

scenario

(noun). tình huống, viễn cảnh

Ex: Let me suggest a possible scenario.

seek

(verb). tìm kiếm

Ex: Drivers are advised to seek alternative routes.

therapist

(noun). nhà trị liệu

Ex: I'm seeing my therapist on Friday morning.

thus

(adverb). do đó, theo cách đó

Ex: The universities have expanded, thus allowing many more people the chance of higher education.

transform

(verb). biến đổi

Ex: It was an event that would transform my life.

consult

(verb). Tham khảo ý kiến

Ex: Have you consulted your lawyer about this?

contrast

(noun). Sự tương phản

Ex: The flowers provide a contrast with the dark background.

diagnosis

(noun). chẩn đoán

Ex: They are waiting for the doctor's diagnosis.

nature

(noun). bản chất

Ex: His work explores the nature of the mother-child relationship.

judgement

(noun). sự đánh giá

Ex: It was, in her judgement, the wrong thing to do.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

training

(noun). sự rèn luyện, sự đào tạo

Ex: The company failed to provide adequate training for staff.

emphasis

(noun). Nhấn mạnh

Ex: Since the elections there has been a greater emphasis on education.

mediate

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: Educational success is mediated by economic factors.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

certificate

(noun). bằng cấp; giấy chứng nhận

Ex: Everyone entering the country needs to show a health certificate.

necessary

(adjective). cần thiết

Ex: Food is necessary for survival.

obtain

(verb). Đạt được, lấy được

Ex: I've been trying to obtain permission to publish this material.

sick leave

(noun). nghỉ ốm

Ex: He was on sick leave following a heart attack.

statutory

(adjective). do luật pháp quy định

Ex: The authority failed to carry out its statutory duties.

permit

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: Mobile phones are not permitted in the examination room.

legally

(adverb). một cách hợp pháp

Ex: Children under 16 are not legally allowed to buy cigarettes.

perhaps

(adverb). có thể

Ex: This is perhaps his best novel to date.

prescribe

(verb). kê đơn

Ex: He may be able to prescribe you something for that cough.

regard

(verb). Đánh giá

Ex: They regarded people outside their own town with suspicion.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

treatment

(noun). Việc chữa trị

Ex: The drug is used in the treatment of depression.

authoritative

(adjective). có căn cứ đích xác

Ex: The book is an authoritative account of the Second World War.

influential

(adjective). có tầm ảnh hưởng

Ex: She is one of the most influential figures in local politics.

practitioner

(noun). người đang hành nghề (đặc biệt về y học và ngành luật)

Ex: Elizabeth Quan is a London-based practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine.

medical

(adjective). Liên quan đến y khoa

Ex: His medical records showed that he was unfit for work.

patient

(noun). Bệnh nhân

Ex: Hospitals are treating more patients than ever before.

pneumonia

(noun). viêm phổi

Ex: She'll catch pneumonia going out without a coat in this weather!

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

draw

(verb). rút ra

Ex: What conclusions did you draw from the report?

specialised

(adjective). chuyên, chuyên gia

Ex: The hospital is unable to provide the highly specialized care needed by very sick babies.

collective

(adjective). tập hợp

Ex: There has to be a balance between individual choice and collective responsibility.

combination

(noun). Sự phối hợp

Ex: His treatment was a combination of surgery, radiation and drugs.

pull oneself together

(verb). bình tĩnh lại, lấy lại lý trí

Ex: Just pull yourself together. There's no point crying about it.

struggle

(verb). Chật vật

Ex: The firm is struggling to cope with the demand for its products.

subjective

(adjective). Chủ quan

Ex: Everyone's opinion is bound to be subjective.

expert

(noun). Chuyên gia

Ex: Experts in the field of child psychology warn of the dangers of social media.

aware

(adjective). Có nhận thức

Ex: They suddenly became aware of people looking at them.

realise

(verb). nhận ra

Ex: They didn't realise the danger they were in.

stage

(noun). giai đoạn

Ex: This technology is still in its early stages.

suffer

(verb). chịu đựng

Ex: The company suffered huge losses in the last financial year.

knowledge

(noun). kiến thức

Ex: They enjoy sharing their knowledge of the business.

symptom

(noun). triệu chứng

Ex: Cigarettes can aggravate the symptoms of a cold.

tiredness

(noun). sự mệt mỏi

Ex: He said that it was tiredness that led him to make the mistake.

unwell

(adjective). không ổn, ốm

Ex: She said she was feeling unwell and went home.

blood pressure

(noun). huyết áp

Ex: The nurse will take your blood pressure in a moment.

chest

(noun). ngực

Ex: She folded her arms across her chest.

measurement

(noun). sự đo lường

Ex: Accurate measurement is very important in science.

temperature

(noun). Nhiệt độ

Ex: The climate is generally mild, and freezing temperatures are almost unknown.

available

(adjective). có sẵn

Ex: We'll send you a copy as soon as it becomes available.

common sense

(noun). lẽ thường tình

Ex: It’s common sense to keep medicines away from children.

describe

(verb). miêu tả

Ex: Can you describe him to me?

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

diverse

(adjective). Đa dạng

Ex: People from diverse cultures were invited to the event.

laboratory

(noun). Phòng thí nghiệm

Ex: The effects of weathering can be simulated in the laboratory.

background

(noun). nền tảng

Ex: The job would suit someone with a business background.

hypothesis

(noun). Giả thuyết

Ex: There is little evidence to support these hypotheses.

previous

(adjective). trước

Ex: No previous experience is necessary for this job.
